# Fixtures for `n64_rom` (Nintendo 64 ROM)

Files made for whiff's tests, CC0-1.0, for a fictitious game (Saltmere Tides). Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/games.sh`.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `tides-byteswapped.v64` | craft_games.py (n64brew header, no boot code; three byte orders) | CC0-1.0 |
| `tides-wordswapped.n64` | craft_games.py (n64brew header, no boot code; three byte orders) | CC0-1.0 |
| `tides.z64` | craft_games.py (n64brew header, no boot code; three byte orders) | CC0-1.0 |
